title: Stitchboard: Multi-owner Coverage Snapshot — April 2028
content:
Purpose:
A one-page quicksheet for cross-functional owners to eyeball weekend/night coverage and short-term handoffs. Not canonical; meant for fast triage and handover notes for the next 72 hours.

How to use: update your row when you take ownership; mark backups clearly; drop a 1-line action if any gap. Keep rows terse.

Quick summary metrics (auto-check):
- total rows: 10
- rows without backup: 3  (hosted-api, model-pool-eu, billing-ingest)
- rows with >1 recent incident: 2 (hosted-api, redis-cache)
- open actions: 4

Table (columns: Component | Primary | Backup | Coverage window | Typical load | Recent incidents | Next action)
1) hosted-api | Aisha P. (oncall) | Luca M. | 00:00-08:00 UTC | 120 rps (p95) | 2028-04-14 03:12 partial timeouts | add circuit-breaker alert, verify fallback policy by EOD
2) dedicated-infra | Priya D. | Ethan W. | 08:00-20:00 UTC | 450 avg qps | none last 7d | schedule infra-capacity brief (Priya)
3) redis-cache | Platform SRE | Priya D. | 24/7 | bursty (cache churn) | 2028-04-13 cache thrash, autoscale delayed | add sharding note + escalation to SRE on repeat
4) model-pool-eu | ML infra lead | Platform SRE | 02:00-10:00 UTC | 3 GPUs reserved | 2028-04-10 cold-start latency spike | confirm quant-profile, add warmup tasks
5) billing-ingest | Payments eng | Finance oncall | 06:00-14:00 UTC | 0.5MB/s avg | 2028-04-12 duplicate events | add dedupe check, assign follow-up to payments
6) embeddings-indexer | Search eng | Solutions eng | 18:00-02:00 UTC | 2 nodes | none | verify S3 lifecycle policy before next run
7) private-deployments-telemetry | Security ops | Customer Success | 24/7 | low | intermittent auth errors 4/7 | patch cred rotation, CS to notify affected clients
8) rollout-console | Product oncall | Devexp | 10:00-18:00 UTC | low writes | 2028-04-11 UI error on rollout | revert partial config, QA fix in PR#224
9) rate-limiter | Infra | Eng-sre | 00:00-12:00 UTC | 6000 TPS peak | 2028-04-14 throttle spike | investigate quota misalignment, temp raise for region-2
10) model-queue-worker | Batch eng | Devops | 14:00-22:00 UTC | variable | none | add visibility to job ETA in status page

Notes and quick context: 
- "Primary" is who should be paged first; "Backup" is second-level owner for that coverage window. If both empty -> coverage gap.
- Coverage window is a guidance for short-term runs (72h focus) not long-term rota.
- Typical load is eyeball metric; if p95 or RPS seems off ping metric-owner in slack #ops-metrics.

Open actions (owner -> action):

- Priya -> short infra capacity brief + list of surge nodes (ETA: 2028-04-17)
- Luca -> confirm backup rotation with Platform SRE for hosted-api night shift (ETA: 2028-04-16)

- billing-ingest: duplicates source traced to partner X or S3 retry? Need one-off debug session.
- rate-limiter: region-2 throttle spike correlated with CDN purge on 2028-04-14; confirm with CDN team.

- high_incident_count = COUNTIF(Recent incidents CONTAINS "partial" OR "spike", 1) -> current 2
